title: The Mysterious Retro Room Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure, Takagi, Chiba) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object), sharing an `order` integer so edges belonging to the same occurrence can be grouped without a reifying node. The old wiki-derived case file (cases/ep214_...) named the correct culprit (Kuniko Yamamoto) and the correct core trick (phone dialed through a plastic bag), so label.murderer_id is unchanged -- but it collapsed everyone's relationship to generic 'knows', omitted the backstory professor who is central to the motive, omitted the third friend witness's role and the dry-cleaning-delivery witness, omitted the ice-cream/candy/string delay mechanism used to fake the TV timing (only vaguely gestured at via one clue+two events), omitted the pepper-spray and room-key reasoning Kogoro used to prove premeditation and that the victim knew her attacker, and got the timeline slightly wrong (the corrected time of death is ~12:20 PM, not simply 'right after turning the TV on' as the initial police guess assumed). case_type: murder.

attrs.time_of_death_estimated_initial: between noon and 1 PM (police estimate, based on false assumption she was attacked right after turning on the TV)
attrs.time_of_death_actual: approximately 12:20 PM, established once the TV coin-timer trick is understood
attrs.found_in: Room 503, the 'Retro Room' of the Dolphinland hotel

attrs.cover_story: claimed to be about to open her own clothing boutique
attrs.true_circumstance: was actually fired from her design job after drinking too much once
attrs.confession: admits she could not forgive Fujimura and felt humiliated and robbed of her happiness

attrs.detail: controlled a prestigious overseas design-job recommendation both Yamamoto and Fujimura sought after graduation; let slip while drinking that Fujimura had used her feminine charms on him

attrs.testimony: delivered dry cleaning to Room 503 before 1 PM but did not enter because of the 'Do Not Disturb' sign, and did not check whether the door was locked

attrs.role: meeting point where Yamamoto rejoins the group and the faked alibi call is placed

attrs.detail: themed replica of a guest room from the hotel's former identity as the Dolphin-Ryokan; furnished with a coin-operated TV and complimentary old-style candy

attrs.trick: taken from the victim's body and used by the killer to dial her own phone, faking an incoming/outgoing call pair timestamped 1:08 PM
attrs.returned: slipped back into the room during the commotion after the body was discovered

attrs.purpose: used to dial a phone without leaving direct fingerprints on the keys
attrs.staging_flaw: left an unusual vertical fingerprint smudge pattern that exactly matches the center-column keys needed to dial Yamamoto's own phone number

attrs.detail: can be dialed using only the center-column buttons -- the layout that produced the telltale vertical smudge on the plastic bag

attrs.significance: unused -- indicates the victim did not perceive her attacker as a threat/stranger, i.e. she knew them

attrs.found_location: left on the table inside Room 503
attrs.significance: door was left unlocked on the way out; a burglar would lock it to delay discovery, so this points to a premeditated, non-burglary murder in which the room needed to stay accessible

attrs.mechanism: one coin buys exactly one hour; auto-shuts-off, and was found off (having run out) at 2 PM when the group entered, meaning it was switched on at 1 PM
attrs.purpose_in_trick: used to fake that the victim was still alive and watching TV around 1 PM, long after she was actually killed

attrs.detail: a fairly new flavor not normally stocked among this room's complimentary selection, so the victim must have bought it separately
attrs.trick_role: placed as a bridge between the TV controls and furniture; melts over time so the string draped across the coin slot slips free and drops a pre-set coin into the slot
attrs.residue: left damp condensation on the channel knob and table

attrs.trick_role: draped over the coin slot with a coin propped by the melting ice cream bar; when the bar melts away the string slips and the coin falls in, delaying the TV's activation by roughly 40 minutes

attrs.purpose: hung on the door by the killer to keep the room unlocked (so the trick would later be visible) while deterring hotel staff from entering early and discovering the body/setup too soon

clues.desc: Phone-log comparison: Fujimura's outgoing call to Yamamoto and Yamamoto's incoming call both log 1:08 PM, but the TV coin-timer mechanism proves Fujimura was already dead by roughly 12:20 PM -- she could not have placed that call, revealing it was faked using the victim's own phone.

Fingerprint-pattern comparison: the odd vertical smudge pattern on the plastic bag in Yamamoto's pocket exactly matches the center-column keys required to dial Yamamoto's own phone number -- proving the bag was used to dial that specific number, not just carried innocently.

edges.detail: seduced the professor to secure the overseas job recommendation both women wanted
recommended Fujimura over Yamamoto for the prestigious overseas design job after being seduced

edges.method: melting ice-cream-bar-and-candy-string delay mechanism drops a coin into the room TV roughly 40 minutes after the killer leaves, making the room look occupied around 1 PM

edges.detail: dials her own phone through the plastic bag using the victim's phone hidden in her pocket, faking a 1:08 PM alibi call
slips the victim's phone back into the room amid the commotion after the body is discovered
